cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put you on wedding replies. You said you'd handle everyone who came to the door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant opening it, not answering invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You know who's coming, then. I'll write the replies; you tell me who needs one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know half your cousins.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the people you do know. I'll take the cousins; you're still handling your half of the door.
